svg.title: Two ways to test the upload app
svg.desc: Laptop preview uses a Python fixture. SAP testing uses a developer transport from DEV to QAS and Gateway publication. Neither requires production.

g.text: Where does the Fiori app send its request?
Available now: Browser → localhost → synthetic data only
After backend delivery: DEV objects → transport → QAS Gateway → QAS ABAP
A GitHub commit is not an SAP transport. No PRD connection is required.
